place: Maricopa Trail, Cave Creek to Lake Pleasant Regional Park, AZ
description: Prickly Pedal, Sunday, January 31, 2027: 36 and 15 mile mountain bike races on the Maricopa Trail from Cave Creek to Lake Pleasant, plus a 10 mile trail run.
headline: Cave Creek To Lake Pleasant
intro: Get in a heart-pumping, rip-roaring ride through the desert terrain of the Maricopa Trail beginning in Cave Creek, AZ and finishing at Lake Pleasant in Peoria, AZ. Not ready for the Full 'Pedal'? Try out the 15 mile, Half Pedal, 'sprint' distance.

MTB not your ride? We have a 10 mile trail run for all of you runners out there. The out and back course starts and finishes at the lake and takes you on a fun, rolling journey to Pipeline Cove and back.

Proceeds from the race help support the Maricopa Trail & Park Foundation, a nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting, promoting, developing, and maintaining one of the nation's largest county park systems. Their mission is to ensure that Maricopa County's trails and parks remain accessible, enjoyable, and sustainable for all visitors.
distance_note: *Distances may vary slightly each year due to permitting.

courses.name: 36 Mile
paras: Featuring a 36 Mile point to point course, the Prickly Pedal starts in Cave Creek in front of the Flat Tire Bike Shop, 6032 E Cave Creek Rd, Cave Creek, AZ 85331, and rides up through town to Spur Cross where you'll join the Maricopa Trail all the way over to the finish line at Lake Pleasant Regional Park's 10 Lane Boat Ramp. Aggressive ascents and descents, grinding it out on the flats, rocks, water, sand, mud, and roller coaster runs are all part of the fun of this challenging course.

The ride features numerous short, steep, rocky climbs and descents, some of which may require you to dismount and hike. Finish times for most racers are estimated at 3 to 4 hours. Two aid stations on course, near mile 15 and mile 30.

courses.name: 15 Mile
paras: The 15 mile 'Sprint' course begins inside the Pioneer Living History Museum. After completing a loop inside the museum, racers exit onto Pioneer Rd. then onto the Maricopa Trail. The first 6.5 miles are relatively flat and fast before encountering some terrain. After the aid station at mile 9 racers enter a beautiful canyon that takes them to the boundary of Lake Pleasant Regional Park. The last three miles are where you will encounter the most climbing.

courses.name: 10 Mile Trail Run
paras: The 10 mile trail run begins and finishes at the 10 Lane Boat Ramp at Lake Pleasant. Runners head up the ramp and cross the street onto Frogs Tank trail, then a steep descent onto Beardsley trail, which loosely parallels the park road. Beardsley connects to Wild Burro trail then onto Pipeline Canyon trail. Runners turn around at Pipeline Cove and retrace their steps back to the boat ramp. One aid station on course.

courses.name: Medical
paras: Our MedStar Solutions medical staff is based at the start and finish headquarters to assist with first aid onsite. Please do NOT call 911 in a medical emergency: call the race day number and they will dispatch immediately.

info.name: Shuttles
paras: Shuttles take MTB racers and their bikes to both start lines from the finish at Lake Pleasant Regional Park. Buy a shuttle ticket on the registration page; it also covers the bike shuttle. Departure times are sent race week.

info.name: Parking
paras: Lake Pleasant Regional Park charges a $10 park entry fee per vehicle for spectators. Racers being dropped off or picked up have the fee waived. Bring cash and carpool.

info.name: Camping
paras: Two group camping sites near the 10 Lane Boat Ramp are reserved for racers: $25 per night per unit through 12/31/26, $30 from 1/1/27. Buy a camping space on the merchandise page.

info.name: Crews, Pacers and Pets
paras: Crews at the start and finish only. No pacers. No pets on course; leashed pets only at the venue.

register_note: Registration closes Mon, Jan 25 @ 11:59PM MT. Prices do not include 6.30% Maricopa County Tax.

volunteer.text: We need help to make Prickly Pedal possible. Volunteer perks include Aravaipa race credits and race swag.

sponsor_note: Prickly Pedal is supported in part by an Arts and Culture grant from the City of Peoria.

aid.name: Aid Stations
paras: There are two Aid Stations on course. The first is near mile 15. The second is near the 30 mile mark. Both will be stocked with water and electrolyte drinks, sweet and salty snacks and fresh fruit. Our main aid station at the finish line will have the same offerings.

aid.name: Drop Bags
paras: We will have an area specified for your personal drop bag at the finish area that will allow for easy and quick access.

a: Crews will be allowed at the start/finish only.
There are no pacers allowed for any distance.
Expect a cold, brisk morning followed by near perfect daytime temperatures. We've occasionally seen rain in the past on this weekend, but it is somewhat rare.

The race courses will be well marked with orange plastic ribbons with black polka dots and reflective medallions. Trail junctions and turns will be well marked with reflective laminated signs. In addition, blue & white checkerboard plastic flagging and RED reflective WRONG WAY signs will be hung to designate non-race trails. All riders are responsible for understanding the layout of the course.
